abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is highly resistant to chemotherapy due to dense stromal barriers. Although gemcitabine remains the standard treatment, its efficacy is limited. Combining it with the pseudopeptide N6L has shown synergistic effects, but administering them individually in biological systems poses significant challenges. To overcome this, we developed a polyanion-gemcitabine conjugate (PAAGem) coupled with N6L, a multivalent cationic ligand with intrinsic anticancer activity. The conjugation was confirmed, and gemcitabine retained its biological activity post-grafting. Quartz crystal microbalance studies revealed electrostatic interactions between PAAGem and N6L, guiding nanoparticle assembly. Building on this strategy, we engineered two electrostatic nanosystems: (i) a multilayer architecture constructed on nanostructured lipid carriers (NLCs) via a layer-by-layer approach, enabling controlled incorporation of cytotoxic agents, and (ii) a simpler polyelectrolyte complex (PEC) formed by spontaneous co-assembly in aqueous media. Colloidal analyses showed superior stability of LbL-NLCs. In murine PDAC cells, LbL-NLCs exhibited markedly enhanced anticancer efficacy compared with free gemcitabine + N6L, whereas PEC formulations provided limited improvement. These results were further validated in vivo. Overall, our study demonstrates that electrostatic multilayer architectures leveraging PAAGem-N6L interactions significantly outperform simple electrostatic complexes, highlighting LbL-functionalized NLCs as a promising nanotherapeutic strategy for PDAC treatment.
key_points_ko: 폴리아니온-젬시타빈 접합체와 N6L의 정전기적 결합을 기반으로 한 층상 집적 지질 나노입자(LbL-NLC)가 개발되었습니다.
마우스 췌장암 세포 실험에서 LbL-NLC는 자유 젬시타빈 및 N6L 병용 투여 대비 현저히 향상된 항암 효과를 보였습니다.
생체 내 동물실험 검증 결과 LbL-NLC 구조가 단순 복합체(PEC)보다 우수한 콜로이드 안정성과 항암 효능을 입증했습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장관선암(PDAC)의 항암제 저항성을 극복하기 위해 젬시타빈(gemcitabine)과 항암 활성을 가진 의사펩타이드 N6L을 결합한 나노전달체 시스템이 개발되었습니다. 연구진은 폴리아니온-젬시타빈 접합체(PAAGem)와 N6L의 정전기적 상호작용을 이용하여 층상 집적 나노구조 지질 수송체(LbL-NLC)와 단순 폴리전해질 복합체(PEC) 두 가지 나노시스템을 제작했습니다. 마우스 췌장암 세포 및 생체 내(in vivo) 평가 결과, LbL-NLC 시스템이 단순 젬시타빈과 N6L 병용투여 및 PEC 복합체보다 현저히 우수한 항암 효과와 안정성을 나타냈습니다.
title: Gemcitabine Delivery and Nucleolin-Targeting Nanocarriers Based on N6L-Functionalized Polyelectrolyte Complexes and Layer-By-Layer Lipid Nanoparticles
title_ko: N6L 기능화 폴리전해질 복합체 및 층상 집적 지질 나노입자 기반의 젬시타빈 전달 및 뉴클레오린 표적 나노캐리어
